title: chat-server: ChatContact create by identity
description: ChatContact/set create accepts only identity; server assigns id; existing identity -> alreadyExists with existingId (RFC 8620 5.3); identity == ownerUserId -> invalidProperties [identity]. ChatContact/query gains exact identity filter. MemoryBackend + ChatBackend trait + chat-client bindings.
notes:
Implemented (uncommitted): handle_contact_set create by identity (invalidProperties for missing/blank identity or extra props; owner identity via new ChatBackend::owner_user_id hook, default Ok(None)); identity uniqueness enforced by backend create_object (AlreadyExists+existingId), documented in create_object uniqueness contract; MemoryBackend identity query filter + set_owner_user_id_for_test; client chat_contact_create + ChatContactQueryInput.filter_identity. Changed integration.rs contact_set_create_forbidden -> contact_set_create_without_identity_invalid_properties (draft contradicts forbidden).
Done in 2fea4cc5: tests contact_create_by_identity_assigns_id, contact_create_existing_identity_already_exists, contact_create_without_identity_invalid_properties, contact_create_other_properties_invalid_properties, contact_query_identity_filter_matches_octet_for_octet, contact_create_owner_identity_invalid_properties; changed existing tests: contact_set_create_forbidden (renamed contact_set_create_without_identity_invalid_properties)
